conclusion: Bounded Tested on 2026-11-03: stock run6 reached SourceReady on native99 with immutable pin 6/integrated/1882a372985949584bc3c15a3df8b2c6a9f21a1b610dd2b583cea70dc44975ac, five intact analysis views 1–5 and proposal tasks 27–31 awaiting_agent. Actual CLI seven-call, external stdio MCP 13-operation (including original artifact bytes and an actual rendered PNG), and seven-stage native export journeys passed, including expected wrong-pin refusals. JSONL/Parquet agree on 1819 rows; detached exports retain 1589 pages, 183085 text items and 107 tables under their explicit schema/inventory checks. Native conversion/recognition reused qualified observations and exact retained recognition attempts without new attempt results; source health remains partial/unknown where reported, and absent candidate/OCR inventory is not fabricated. Owned Nemotron8035 PIDs were stopped; subsequent actual database-backed status succeeded with five awaiting agents and no orphaned tasks. The database remains available. No Claude knowledge execution, reference authoring, grading, semantic-fidelity validation, completed knowledge run or result selection is claimed; those obligations remain separate. Future author bundles and live editable helper paths are excluded from this record custody.
